high_level_description: This image is a photograph titled "Curvy" by Natalya Pyrogova, categorized under Fine Art Photography – Seascape. The photograph captures a dramatic scene of big wave surfing at Nazaré, Portugal. Setting: The setting is the ocean, specifically at Nazaré, Portugal, known for its powerful waves. The water is dark and turbulent, indicating strong currents and high energy. Activity: A surfer is riding inside a large, curling wave. The surfer appears to be skillfully maneuvering through the barrel of the wave
